gizmo.title: Mea pāʻani palapala
gizmo.description: Alakaʻi, hōʻikeʻike a me ke kuhikuhi no kekahi web component, me nā pihi kope no HTML, import, npm a me CDN.

configure.title: Waihona ʻikepili palapala
configure.description: Ka ʻikepili palapala e hele pū ana me ka mea (lib/tag.docs.json).

configure.title: Papa moʻolelo alakaʻi
configure.description: Ka papa moʻolelo neʻe e hele pū ana me ka mea (tag.motion.json). Koho.

configure.title: Haʻawina wikiō
configure.description: He wikiō pōkole e pili ana i ka mea (YouTube, Vimeo a i ʻole waihona wikiō). Pani i ka wikiō ma ka ʻikepili palapala.

configure.title: Wehe ma ka lepa
configure.description: ʻO ka lepa hea e hōʻike mua ʻia.

configure.title: Pāʻani ʻakomi i ke alakaʻi
configure.description: Hoʻomaka i ke alakaʻi i ka wā e hōʻike ʻia ai ka mea pāʻani. Haʻalele ʻia inā makemake ka mea heluhelu i ka neʻe emi.

advanced.title: Kumuhana alakaʻi
advanced.description: No nā mea me nā alakaʻi he nui, ʻo ke kumuhana hea e wehe mua ai (no ka laʻana add-blocks). E waiho hakahaka no ka mea nui.

advanced.title: Loulou hōʻikeʻike ola
advanced.description: Ma hea e hele ai ke pihi Wehe i ke kumu hōʻikeʻike. Paʻamau i ka waihona demo ma ka waihona code.

advanced.title: Loulou palapala
advanced.description: Ma hea e hele ai ke pihi palapala piha, no ka laʻana ka ʻaoʻao Learn HAX e kūlike ana.
